acceptance_criteria: .handoff is resynced/readable before new plan/task edits: hf doctor reports health OK after migrating the legacy Weave handoff ledger to redb, with the legacy SQLite backup path recorded.
The broken `/home/drdave/Desktop/weave-x86_64` dashboard/icon artifact is traced: it is weave 0.1.0 and has no dashboard subcommand; current default builds also omit feature-gated HTTP dashboard.
A default-build `weave tui` terminal dashboard exists with deterministic `--once`, `--json`, `--pane`, `--filter`, and `--no-color` modes.
The TUI covers overview, sessions, messages, asks, jobs, graph intelligence, leases, and command catalog panes without adding dependencies.
A black-box integration test enumerates the current top-level command surface from `weave --help` expectations and exercises a documented help path for every command.
Black-box TUI tests prove `weave tui --once --no-color`, `weave tui --pane graph --once`, and `weave tui --json --pane commands` work in the default build.
Generated handoff redb/RVF/lock sidecars remain ignored so local sync/migration state does not pollute git status.
objective: Build Weave toward a real terminal dashboard TUI like `icm dashboard`, after resyncing `.handoff` with the current handoff kernel state. Trace the broken `/home/drdave/Desktop/weave-x86_64` dashboard/icon artifact, explain what happened, and implement a default-build terminal dashboard surface so operators are not dependent on the feature-gated HTTP dashboard or a stale Desktop ELF. Walk the current `weave --help` command surface, include graph-intelligence/operator workflows, and add test contracts that exercise every top-level command help path plus the new TUI.
title: Plan and implement real terminal dashboard TUI plus command coverage gate
